blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Electron ptychography recovers atomic structure from 4D-STEM data: diffraction patterns at multiple positions of a scanned probe. Current codes reconstruct an image and read atoms off it, or fit atoms under an $L_1$ loss; neither gives per-atom uncertainty. We propose 4D-TEMPO, a differentiable physical renderer that fits the atoms, the microscope, and the detector directly to the recorded electron counts under a Poisson likelihood. The output is a list of atoms, each a Gaussian primitive with a 3D position, a thermal width, and a model-conditional error bar from the Fisher information. The Fisher information also conditions the solver, gives the dose (electrons per Å$^2$) each parameter needs, and separates calibration from imaging. On a simulated WSe$_2$ bilayer, starting from the published reconstruction, fitted atoms cut in-plane error by a third (3.2 vs. 4.8 pm) and depth error by 40-61% against its 3D peaks. Depth comes from multiple scattering into the dark field, the faint counts outside the direct beam. The two layers, $10\times$ closer than the depth of field, separate; per-atom depth then follows the layer geometry. When the model is well specified, the bars are calibrated (69% of position coordinates within $1σ$). On experimental WSe$_2$, fitted atoms predict held-out patterns better than the three published codes we test. With free probe modes where atoms are incomplete, the same likelihood predicts best on all three held-out benchmarks, matches every WSe$_2$ baseline in 5 min against up to 20.5 h, and passes torchslice at its released setting 180$\times$ sooner on PrScO$_3$. Per-atom error bars, planned doses, and fast reconstruction point to low-dose, real-time 3D imaging of beam-sensitive and dynamic materials.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Can a microscope report every atom’s position with an error bar ( Fig. 1 )? Electron ptychography comes closest. A focused electron probe scans a thin specimen, and a detector records a diffraction pattern of Poisson counts at every position: a four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) dataset ( Fig. 1 a). Current codes reconstruct a pixel image from these patterns and add freedom until the fit is good: free probe modes – mutually incoherent wavefields of unconstrained pixels – absorb what the physics misses, including part of the atoms’ own signal ( Fig. 2 ). The fit improves, but it can no longer say how well it knows any one atom. 4D-TEMPO puts atoms before pixels: it fits atoms, the microscope, and the detector directly to the counts, as crystallographic refinement fits a structure to diffraction data [ 45 ] . In vision terms, this is inverse rendering via “analysis by synthesis”: a physical renderer – the multislice model of electron scattering – maps Gaussian atoms to expected patterns, much as NeRF fits a radiance field to photos [ 44 ] . The differentiable renderer gives its Jacobian and the Fisher information (FI): an error bar for every atom, which parameters the data determine, and the dose an experiment needs, in advance ( Fig. 1 c).
blocks.zh: 显微镜能否用出错栏(图1)报告每个原子的位置? 电平面图最接近了 聚焦电子探测器扫描出一薄的标本,而探测器则记录出普瓦生在每个位置都计数的分光图案:四维扫描传输电子显微镜(4D-STEM)数据集(图1 a). 当前代码从这些图案重建出一幅像素图像,并添加了自由度,直到合适: 自由探针模式 — — 互不相通的波场不受约束的像素 — — 吸收物理所忽略的东西,包括原子本身的部分信号(图2). 适合性会改善,但不能说它知道 任何一个原子有多好。 4D-TEMPO在像素之前放入原子:它能将原子,显微镜,和探测器直接与计数相接合,因为晶体学的完善适合一个结构来分解数据[45]. 在视觉方面,这是通过“合成分析”的反向渲染:一种物理渲染器 — — 电子散射的多切片模型 — — 将高斯原子与预期的图案相映射,就像NERF与相片相匹配的光场[44]一样。 相异的渲染器提前给出了它的Jacobian和Fisher信息(FI):每个原子都有一个出错栏,用于参数数据决定,以及实验所需的剂量(图1c).

blocks.en: A 300 kV electron has wavelength λ = 2 \lambda=2 pm, but lens aberrations limit the beam to a cone of semi-angle α \alpha of tens of milliradians, setting the diffraction-limited resolution λ / α \lambda/\alpha to 0.66 Å (1 Å = 100 pm) at 30 mrad. Electron ptychography shifts this limit from optics to computation, reaching 0.39 Å in a 2D material [ 24 ] and the thermal-vibration limit (20 pm resolution) [ 6 ] , recovering depth, and enabling low-dose imaging of frozen biological specimens [ 72 ] . The dose, the number of electrons sent through each Å 2 of specimen, is capped by the specimen itself: each electron can deposit energy that breaks bonds or knocks atoms out. Frozen biological specimens tolerate tens of electrons per Å 2 ; in the WSe 2 bilayer studied here, selenium vacancies appear by about 5 × 10 5 5\times 10^{5} [ 22 ] . Every electron must therefore count. 3D atom positions and vibrations reveal how twisted 2D crystal layers relax [ 22 ] , how moiré phasons dominate atomic vibrations [ 69 ] , how atoms vibrate under heating [ 2 ] , and where hydrogen sits in metals [ 57 ] . Each question demands quantitative numbers with error bars; beam-sensitive and changing specimens also demand low dose and reconstruction fast enough to follow them.
blocks.zh: 300千伏电子有波长 = 2\lambda=2平米,但透镜偏差将光束限制为相圆锥相半角α\α相几十毫拉dian,将分光-受限分辨率 = / α\lambda/\alpha 确定为 0.66 Å (1 Å=100平米) 在 30 Merad. 电平面图将这一限制从光学转向计算,在2D材料中达到0.39 Ö,热振能极限(20 pm分辨率)[6],恢复深度,并允许对被冻结的生物标本进行低剂量成像[72]. 剂量,即通过每个 2标本发送的电子数量被标本本身所封顶: 每个电子可以沉积出能打破键或将原子敲出. 冰冻的生物标本能容忍每A2的数十个电子;在此处研究的WSe 2双层中,硒空出约5×10 5\times 10\5}[22]. 因此,每个电子都必须计算在内。 3D原子位置和振动揭示出扭曲的2D晶层是如何放松的[22],莫伊雷活塞如何支配原子振动[69],原子在取暖下如何振动[2],氢在金属中的位置[57]. 每个问题都需要带出错条的量化数字;光束敏感和变化中的标本也需要低剂量并快速地进行重建以跟随它们.

blocks.en: Three computational obstacles stand in the way. 1) A dataset contains up to 10 9 10^{9} measurements, and multiple scattering makes the renderer strongly nonlinear. 2) Microscope aberrations, coherence, and detector response are known only approximately and must be fitted with the specimen. 3) Existing codes reconstruct millions of pixels per slice with free probe modes [ 61 ] , introduced for partial coherence but tied to neither source nor lens, so they absorb detector blur, drift, and model error with specimen signal.
blocks.zh: 三起计算障碍相碍. 1)一个数据集包含最多10个9个10-XX9)的测量,多发散使渲染器强烈地非线性. 2) 显微镜异常,一致性,和探测器反应仅约可知,必须同标本相接. 3)已存在的代码用自由探针模式重建了每片上百万像素 [61],为部分一致性而引入,但既无源又无相镜头,因此它们能以标本信号来吸收探测器模糊,漂移,和模型出错.

blocks.en: Maximum-likelihood ptychography under Poisson or Gaussian noise [ 60 , 47 ] reconstructs these pixel grids and extracts atom positions and uncertainties post hoc, as in the published pipeline for twisted tungsten diselenide (WSe 2 ) bilayers [ 22 ] . Yet atoms are far fewer than pixels, and an atom’s potential is a known function of position, species, and thermal width. Diederichs et al . put atoms directly into the inversion, fitting atoms and a physical instrument to experimental 4D-STEM data via differentiable multislice under an L 1 L_{1} loss [ 11 ] . Meanwhile, the FI has designed STEM experiments for atom-column positions [ 64 ] and bounded 4D-STEM precision [ 12 ] . We take the next step: atoms, instrument, and pixels share one Poisson likelihood with a physical detector model. We add free modes only to test the likelihood and where atoms are incomplete.
blocks.zh: Poisson或高斯噪音下的最大相像平面图[60,47] 重建了这些像素网格并提取原子位置和随机后不确定性,如被公布的被扭曲的钨脱脱(WSe 2)双层管 [22]. 然而原子远小于像素,一个原子的潜力是已知的位置、物种和热宽的函数。 Diederichs等人将原子直接放入倒置中,安装了原子和一个物理仪器,通过可分辨的多晶片在L1 LQQ1}损失下将实验性4D-STEM数据放入倒置中[11]. 与此同时,FI为原子柱位置设计了STEM实验[64]并定界了4D-STEM精度[12]. 我们采取下一步:原子、仪器和像素 与一个物理探测器模型共享一个普瓦生概率。 我们添加免费模式只是为了测试可能性和原子不完整的地方.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Free probe modes make each atom less determined. (a) A physical microscope makes probes only from a small family set by its aberrations χ \chi and coherence ( σ f \sigma_{f} , σ src \sigma_{\mathrm{src}} ): the dots, which lie in a plane ( Eq. 13 ). A free probe mode can be any wave, so it can leave the plane. (b) Each arrow is how the predicted counts change when one parameter moves, in units of the noise. Only the part of an atom’s arrow 𝐚 k \mathbf{a}_{k} that no instrument change can imitate, its height | R k ​ k | |R_{kk}| above the instrument’s span, informs that atom and sets its error bar ( § 6 ). Free modes widen the span to the red plane, imitate more of the atom’s signal, and shrink | R k ​ k | |R_{kk}| .

• Atoms and instrument fitted to the counts. Atoms, a physical instrument, and the detector share one Poisson likelihood, so atoms come out as numbers. On a simulated bilayer, starting from the published reconstruction and using no structural priors, fitted atoms cut in-plane error by a third (3.2 vs. 4.8 pm) and depth error by 40–61% against its 3D peaks ( Tab. 3 ). Multiple scattering into the dark field separates two layers 10 × 10\times closer than the depth of field. The solver is quasi-Newton in scaled units on a deterministic objective, and atom depth is continuous across slices ( §§ 3 and 4 ). • Every atom with an error bar. The FI gives each atom a shot-noise precision, calibrated in simulation (69% of position coordinates within 1 ​ σ 1\sigma , nominal 68%), identifiability via pivoted QR, and the dose required per parameter ( §§ 5.3 and 6 ; cf. Laplace approximations of neural fields [ 17 ] ). Calibrate once, image at low dose: a Schur complement separates calibration from imaging, cutting the parameters a low-dose scan must fit by 3 × 3\times ( Fig. 6 ). On an independent simulator, planted 5–20 pm displacements are recovered (median 1.6 pm) with no false ones (§S4). • The same model predicts best. We score every code by held-out Poisson deviance per pixel, D H D_{H} (lower is better). Atoms alone beat every baseline on unseen bilayer patterns (0.450 vs. 0.455 for fold_slice ); a calibrated 1% detector distortion widens the lead to 0.024. With free probe modes, our fit leads on all three benchmarks: by 0.053 on the WSe 2 bilayer, by 0.07–0.33 on a 21 nm praseodymium scandium oxide (PrScO 3 ) crystal, where one baseline runs 5 × 5\times longer, and by 0.46–0.53 on a lead zirconate titanate (PZT) film ( § 5.4 ; §§S2, S9). • Fast mode. The free-mode fit matches every WSe 2 baseline after 5 min, vs. 22 min for PtyRAD and 20.5 h for fold_slice , and passes torchslice ’s best PrScO 3 score 180 × \times sooner; a 1 h atom refinement of the published reconstruction beats its in-plane error ( § 5.4 ). Sections S0–S18 are in the supplement.

blocks.en: Fast mode. The free-mode fit matches every WSe 2 baseline after 5 min, vs. 22 min for PtyRAD and 20.5 h for fold_slice , and passes torchslice ’s best PrScO 3 score 180 × \times sooner; a 1 h atom refinement of the published reconstruction beats its in-plane error ( § 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 快速模式 。 Free-mode在5分钟后匹配每个WSe 2基线, PtyRAD vs. 22 min用于折叠-slices , 和 20.5 h用于折叠-slics, 并且通过火炬-slices 3 的最佳 PrScO 3 得分 180 ×\ times 更早; 对已公布重建的 1 h 原子的完善比起其平面错误(§ 5.4).

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Phase retrieval and ptychography. Detectors record intensity without phase. Gerchberg and Saxton posed this for electron micrographs [ 16 ] , and Fienup needed only a support constraint [ 14 ] . Ptychography supplies measurement diversity physically, as every point lies in tens to hundreds of overlapping patterns. The ptychographical iterative engine (PIE) [ 53 ] , difference map [ 62 ] , and its extension ePIE [ 39 ] recover object and probe; probe modes model partial coherence [ 61 ] ; Fourier ptychography swaps probe and pupil [ 70 ] ; and multislice electron ptychography reaches the thermal-vibration limit [ 24 , 6 ] . These reconstruct pixels, as do our baselines: fold_slice , built on PtychoShelves [ 67 , 6 ] and Odstrčil et al . ’s maximum-likelihood solver [ 47 ] , and the autodiff package PtyRAD [ 31 ] ; py4DSTEM is another [ 56 , 66 ] .
blocks.zh: 相位检索与平面图. 探测器记录强度不相干. Gerchberg和Saxton为电子微图[16]提出了这个方案,而Fienup只需要支持约束[14]. 造型图提供物理上的测量多样性,因为每一点都存在于数十到数百个重叠的图案中. pychographical迭接引擎(PIE) [53],差分图 [62],及其扩展的ePIE [39] 回收对象和探测器;探测模式模型部分一致性 [61]; Fourier ptychography 互换探测器和瞳孔 [70];多子电子平面图达到热振能极限[24,6]. 这些重建像素,以及我们的基线:折叠-slices, 建于 PtychoShelves [67, 6] 和 Odstrčil et al. 最大相似度解析器 [47], 和自定义包 PtyRAD [31]; py4DSTEM 是另一个 [56, 66] 。

blocks.en: Atoms fitted to diffraction data. Diederichs et al . first fitted atoms and a physical instrument, with frozen phonons, to experimental 4D-STEM data [ 11 ] ; Herdegen et al . recover thermal displacements in simulation [ 21 ] . We share their autodiff through multislice, pathwise width gradients, and atomic parameterization, but fix phonon configurations so our objective is deterministic rather than redrawing them at each Adam/SGD step. Singh et al . and Mani et al . map pixels to Gaussian atoms for tomography [ 58 , 41 ] , while crystallography refines positions and Gaussian displacements via maximum likelihood [ 45 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 配有分解数据的原子。 Diederichs等人首先为实验性4D-STEM数据安装了原子和物理仪器并配有冷冻发音[11]; Herdegen等人在模拟中恢复了热位移[21]. 我们通过多切片、路径宽度梯度和原子参数化来分享它们的自发性, 但是固定光子配置,所以我们的目标是确定性,而不是在亚当/SGD的每个步骤重划它们。 Singh等.和Mani等将像素映射到高斯原子进行成像[58,41],而晶体学则通过最大概率来细化位置和高斯的迁移[45,1].

blocks.en: Physics-based inverse imaging in vision. Cloud tomography inverts multiple scattering [ 32 , 54 ] , and neural fields image black holes [ 33 , 13 ] . Cryo-electron microscopy pairs single scattering with a neural volume [ 71 , 34 ] , NFH-SEM learns a scanning electron microscope forward model [ 5 ] , and generative priors [ 43 ] and neural fields [ 35 , 8 ] regularize electron ptychography and tomography. Single-photon imaging similarly fits an inhomogeneous Poisson model (with dead time and jitter) to raw timestamps of single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) rather than histogramming detections [ 68 ] . None reports per-parameter uncertainty; of these, only cloud tomography inverts multiple scattering. Chien et al . leave validating the implicit prior open; held-out deviance and bar coverage (§§S4, S7) test it.
blocks.zh: 视觉中基于物理的反向成像. 云映射反相多起散相 [32,54],神经场影像黑洞 [33,13]. NFH-SEM学习了扫描电子显微镜前导模型[5],基因前导[43]和神经领域[35,8]将电子平面图和成像图规范化. 单光子成像类似地符合不相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干 无人报告每参数的不确定性;其中只有云层成像图反转多发散. Chien等人对先前隐含的开放进行验证;坚持不动和酒吧覆盖( " S4, S7 " )检验。

blocks.en: Representations and priors. Learned reconstructors [ 48 , 38 ] , deep image priors [ 63 ] , and diffusion priors [ 9 , 4 ] regularize inversions with networks; in ptychography, they provide fast initialization but import training biases and hold only near training conditions, so we experiment with one solely as a warm start (§S9). Neural fields and Gaussian splatting fit one scene via differentiable rendering ( § 1 ). Our atoms are physical Gaussians, each equipped with an FI error bar.
blocks.zh: 陈述及前事. 所学的重建者[48,38],深相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 神经场和高斯电镀通过不同的渲染方式适合一个场景(§1). 我们的原子是物理高斯人,每个原子都配备了FI出错栏.

We synthesize V n V_{n} in Fourier space on an oversampled grid via one matrix product per slice.
In layered specimens, atoms sit in their atomic-plane slices and layer planes shift together via a fitted interlayer distance. blocks.en: 4 Inference and error bounds
blocks.zh: 4 推断和错误界限

blocks.en:
Over training positions T T and pixels in the band-limited disc, we minimize Eq. 7 plus weak Gaussian priors on atom displacements (0.3 Å), scan polynomial, log ⁡ σ f \log\sigma_{f} , log ⁡ σ src \log\sigma_{\mathrm{src}} , and non-defocus aberrations. Per-position offsets are bounded by 1 Å, and the 12 gauge directions mimicking other parameters (mean offset and scan-polynomial projection) are removed exactly. Gradients use reverse-mode autodiff through the potential and FFT multislice Eq. 4 , a network whose layers are slices [ 65 , 11 ] .
Fits from a coarse start run Adam [ 27 ] on mini-batches of positions; every fit then polishes with full-batch L-BFGS [ 36 ] and strong-Wolfe line search. Each polish freezes the probe-mode basis of Eq. 13 to minimize a smooth objective, refreshing between polishes until a refresh moves the objective by less than 1 nat (optimizer ablation: §S17(g)).
On real data the FI also sets the optimization metric, scaling every parameter by its Fisher standard deviation (FI computed once near the optimum); simulated-bilayer fits use fixed per-group scales.
Convergence is tested via the squared Newton decrement 𝐠 ⊤ ​ ℐ − 1 ​ 𝐠 \mathbf{g}^{\!\top}\mathcal{I}^{-1}\mathbf{g} ( ℐ \mathcal{I} : FI plus prior precision) on training patterns, in squared error-bar units; we stop below 0.1 with every step below 0.1 sd (§S17).

blocks.en: 5.1 Data
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据

blocks.en:
We test accuracy against truth ( § 5.2 ), precision under the model ( § 5.3 ), and prediction of unseen experimental patterns and speed ( § 5.4 ) on the datasets of Tab. 1 . Our main dataset is a twisted WSe 2 bilayer recorded at 80 kV and 25 mrad on an aberration-corrected microscope with a pixelated detector [ 69 ] .
For accuracy, we use the simulated twisted bilayer of Huang et al . [ 22 ] : 1,928 atoms rendered with Prismatic [ 49 ] under matching conditions, tilted 12.7 ∘ , with Poisson counts at 2.2 × 10 5 2.2\times 10^{5} e/Å 2 . Our thick benchmark is the public PrScO 3 [001] crystal of Chen et al . [ 6 , 7 ] (21 nm, or 4.9 depths of field at 300 kV).

blocks.en: 5.2 Accuracy against truth

blocks.en: The two layers lie 6.6 Å apart, 10 × 10\times closer than the depth of field λ / α 2 = 67 \lambda/\alpha^{2}=67 Å. Pixel reconstructions blur them along the beam, and 3D phase-peak depths are off by 84 pm (W) and 127 pm (Se) on simulated data ( Fig. 5 ). An atom model replaces that volume with three coordinates per atom. Multiple scattering across both layers shapes the dark field and constrains them. We start from atoms read off the published reconstruction, one plane per layer, and fit every depth freely without structural priors. In-plane, our atoms beat the published accuracy even after its priors ( Tab. 3 ). With depth polished to the likelihood minimum, they end at 50 pm (W) and 49 pm (Se); prior-refined coordinates remain best (5.3 and 5.5 pm). The FI bounds single-atom depth at 8.0 pm rms ( 1.2 × 10 − 3 ​ λ / α 2 1.2\times 10^{-3}\,\lambda/\alpha^{2} ; 0.34 pm in-plane), close to the 6.4 pm rms of flat tilted layers, and the likelihood of one atom’s depth is indeed 5–9 pm wide. The likelihood is thus sharp in depth, but mismatch with the simulator displaces its minimum from truth (§S6); the priors of Huang et al . supply the rest.

blocks.en: With the instrument profiled, species widths on the 25 mrad bilayer are U \sqrt{U} = 7.35 ± \pm 0.03 pm (0.044 λ / α \lambda/\alpha ) for W and 8.98 ± \pm 0.04 pm for Se, with sandwich bars (robust bars from per-pattern score scatter) of 0.15 and 0.13 pm. These effective widths exceed the ≈ \approx 5.5 pm molecular-dynamics value because static displacements, vacancies, and drift add to thermal motion. Zhang et al . read per-atom vibration amplitudes from phase reconstructions of these data and traced them to moiré phasons [ 69 ] . Against an independent multislice simulation, our model underestimates widths by ∼ \sim 1 pm (8–12%) due to a 3–7% dark-field intensity deficit (§S4). Per atom, median width bars are 0.68 pm (W) and 1.36 pm (Se) across the 236 interior atoms. Every width is nearly uncorrelated with each instrument parameter ( | r | ≤ 0.07 |r|\leq 0.07 ), and profiling the instrument leaves the species-width bars essentially unchanged (§S4). Untying the two Se atoms in each column splits them laterally by a median of 0.10 Å at an earlier fit and improves held-out prediction. The independent simulation recovers planted splits of this size (7 of 7 from 0.05 Å) without generating false splits from misfit, bonding charge, or vacancies (§S4).

blocks.en: 5.4 Prediction and speed
blocks.zh: 5.4 预测和速度

blocks.en: With atoms in place of pixels and free modes, the atom fit beats every baseline on unseen bilayer patterns with the smallest train–test gap; a 1% detector ellipse, calibrated from the bright-field rim, widens its lead to 0.024 per pixel ( Tab. 2 , §S14). Pixels and eight free probe modes under the same likelihood predict best: 0.029 per pixel ahead of the calibrated atom fit, 0.053 below fold_slice and 0.071–0.079 below PtyRAD . On the low-count bilayer the likelihood drives this margin: on the same model, data, and optimizer, L 1 L_{1} and amplitude least squares lose 0.058 and 0.054 per pixel (§S2), and fold_slice and PtyRAD optimize amplitude losses.
blocks.zh: 由于原子取代了像素和自由模式,原子适合在不见的双层模式上以最小的列车-测试缺口来击败每个基线;从亮地边缘校正的1%的探测器椭圆,使其铅被扩大为每像素0.024 (Tab. 2, §S14). 同概率下的像素和8个自由探针模式预测最佳:每像素比被校准的原子适中多出0.029分,折叠-slice下出0.053分,PtyRAD下出0.071-0.079分. 在低分数双层上,概率驱动了这个比值:在同一模型上,数据和优化器L 1 L_{1}和振幅最小平方每像素损失0.058和0.054 (§S2),并折叠_slic和PtyRAD优化振幅损失.

blocks.en: On thick PrScO 3 and PZT, our free-mode fit leads every code by 0.07–0.53 per pixel, on PrScO 3 mostly through the fitted detector blur; Poisson pays at low counts ( Tab. 2 ; §§S2, S8, S10).
blocks.zh: 在厚厚的PrScO 3和PZT上,我们的自由模式每像素以0.07-0.53的比分引导每个代码,在PrScO 3上,大部分通过安装的探测器模糊; Poisson以低价支付(Tab. 2; " S2", S8, S10)。

blocks.en: The fast mode cuts the wait for a reconstruction from a day to minutes. On one A6000, the free-mode fit matches every bilayer baseline after 5.3 min ( D H D_{H} 0.453 vs. 0.455), against 22 min for PtyRAD and 20.5 h for fold_slice (A5000, published settings). It reaches 0.4025 after 53 min. On PrScO 3 it passes the best torchslice score in 95 s vs. 4.7 h (§§S9, S11). The sub-scan takes about 1 s to record, so reconstruction time over acquisition time falls from 7 × 10 4 7\times 10^{4} to 3 × 10 2 3\times 10^{2} ; near one, the fit can steer the next scan.
blocks.zh: 快速模式将等待重建的时间从一天缩短为几分钟. 在一个A6000上,自由模式匹配5.3分(DH DQQH}0.453对0.455)后的每一双层基线,而PtyRAD为22分,而折叠-slices为20.5分(A5000已公布设置)。 53分钟后达到0.4025分. 在PrScO 3上,它通过了95 s vs 4.7 h ("S9", S11)中的最佳火炬分数. 子扫描大约需要1 s才能录取,因此在获取时间之后的重建时间从7×10 4 7\times 10^{4}到3×10 2 3\times 10^{2};相近一,相机可以引导下一次扫描.

blocks.en: 6 Identifiability and model error
blocks.zh: 6 识别和模型错误

blocks.en: Atom-by-atom multiple scattering via Foldy–Lax [ 15 , 30 ] with partial-wave T-matrices [ 55 ] is our reference, exact for static atoms of a given potential. With slices at atomic planes, multislice matches dark-field amplitudes of the bilayer’s mean-field columns within 1%, while the tabulated potential [ 50 ] differs from partial waves by + 1.6 % +1.6\% to − 4.8 % -4.8\% (§S18).
blocks.zh: 通过Foldy-Lax [15,30] 和部分波 T-matrices [55] 的原子相接多颗散射物是我们参考的,精确地表示某种潜力的静态原子. 在原子平面上切片时,多切片在1%范围内与双层平面柱的暗地振幅相匹配,而列表中的潜力[50]与部分波值相去甚远:+ 1.6% + 1.6% + 1.6% → − 4.8% - 4.8% → (§S18)。

The FI answers two questions before an experiment: which parameters the counts determine, and what dose a target precision needs. At 100 e/Å 2 , a dose for beam-sensitive specimens, fixing the calibrated instrument, coma included, and the widths from a high-dose scan, and refitting positions, a smooth scan model, defocus, two-fold astigmatism, and one jitter, estimates 3 × 3\times fewer parameters and tightens position bounds by 24% (W) and 6% (Se), if coma holds to well within 30 nm, as between scans minutes apart (§S16).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: An atom with an error bar turns atomic imaging into hypothesis testing: whether an atom moved by 5 pm, or a width changed with temperature, is a test against a stated bar ( § 5.3 ), once model error is budgeted ( § 6 ) or cancels between scans on one instrument. The FI states what each electron tells about each parameter, the limit any reconstruction faces, and so makes the experiment designable. It gives the dose each parameter needs before the scan, and after one high-dose calibration a low-dose scan fits 3 × 3\times fewer parameters ( Fig. 6 ). That is the route to beam-sensitive materials and, with known molecular fragments as primitives, to frozen biological specimens. As fit time approaches acquisition time (now minutes for a 1 s scan, from 20.5 h), the fit can steer the next scan and follow a process, such as a defect forming under the beam, while it happens. Two steps remain: forward models accurate enough that counts alone limit each atom, and event-driven detectors, now reaching the market, that timestamp each electron [ 23 ] , as SPADs do photons [ 68 ] , so the likelihood absorbs drift and dynamics.
blocks.zh: 带有出错条的原子会将原子成像转化为假想测试:无论是一个原子在平时5点移动,还是一个宽度随温度变化而改变,都是针对一个声明条(§ 5.3)的测试,一旦模型出错被编入预算(§ 6),或者在一个仪器上扫描之间取消. FI说明了每个电子对每个参数的描述,限制任何重建面,因此使得实验可以设计. 它在扫描前给出了每个参数需要的剂量,在一次高剂量校正后,低剂量扫描符合3×3\times更少的参数(图6). 这就是通向光线敏感材料的路线, 以及已知的分子碎片作为原始的, 通向被冻结的生物标本。 随着"适时"临近获取时间(现在1 s扫描的分钟从20.5 h开始),适时可以引导下个扫描并遵循一个过程,比如在光束下形成缺陷,同时发生. 还剩下两个步骤:前向模型精度足够高,能单数地限制每个原子,以及事件驱动的探测器,现在已上市,每个电子都印有时间戳 [23],就像SPAD做光子 [68],所以可能性能吸收漂移和动力学.

blocks.en:
Each bar is a model-conditional bound, which per-atom misfit on the bilayer exceeds ( § 6 ) until diffuse scattering and coherence are better modeled. At published doses, counts constrain single-atom depth no better than layer geometry ( § 5.2 ); on real data we fit atoms in their atomic planes, so we do not resolve two atoms of one layer in depth.
The fit neither adds nor removes atoms. In specimens tens of nm thick, every method, ours included, is challenged, since a column spans tens of atoms. We fit pixels there while building a joint column model (§S10).
blocks.zh:
每个条是模式-条件绑定,在散射和一致性得到更好的模型之前,半原子在双层层上被误配超过(§6). 在公布的剂量下,计数限制单原子深度不比地层几何(§ 5.2)更好;在真实的数据上,我们把原子放入他们的原子平面中,因此我们不会在深度中解决一层的两个原子.
配体既不增加也不去除原子. 在数十纳米厚的标本中,包括我们在内的每一种方法都受到挑战,因为一柱跨出几十个原子. 我们在那里安装像素,同时建立一个联合列模型(§S10).

blocks.en: S0. Physical picture
blocks.zh: S0. 物理图片

blocks.en: Source. A field-emission gun emits electrons, accelerated through 80–300 kV. At 80 kV an electron moves at half the speed of light and has a wavelength λ = 4.18 \lambda=4.18 pm. The source has a finite size and the electrons a small spread of energies. The first blurs the probe across the beam; the second, through the lens’s chromatic aberration, blurs its focus. These are the two partial-coherence parameters, σ src \sigma_{\mathrm{src}} and σ f \sigma_{f} .
blocks.zh: 来源. 外出炮发射电子,加速到80-300千伏. 在80千伏时,一电子以光速的一半移动,并有波长QQ = 4.18\lambda= 4.18平方米. 源有可限能大小而电子能有小的传播. 第一种模糊了探针横穿横梁;第二种通过镜头的色调偏差,模糊了它的焦点. 以上是两个部分一致的参数: \ src\ sigma\ mathrm{ src}和\ sigma\ f}

blocks.en: Probe. Condenser lenses and an aberration corrector focus the beam, and an aperture limits its angles to a semi-angle α \alpha . The probe at the specimen is about λ / α \lambda/\alpha across (1.7 Å for the bilayer). Its shape is set by the residual aberrations: defocus, astigmatism, coma and spherical aberration.
blocks.zh: 试取. 收缩镜和反常修正器将光束聚焦,而孔径将其角限制在半角α-α. 标本上的探测器大约是 \\ / α\ lambda/\ alpha 横跨 1. 7 的双层。 它的外形由残留的畸形所设定:去焦,异形,昏迷和球形畸形.

blocks.en: One electron at a time. At picoampere currents electrons are nanoseconds, meters, apart. They do not interact. Each one propagates as a wave, interferes with itself, and is detected once, as a particle, at one pixel. The diffraction pattern is a histogram of these detections. Its expected value is the wave’s intensity, and its fluctuations are counting noise.
blocks.zh: 一次一个电子. 在picoampere电流下,电子是纳米秒,米,相隔. 他们不互动。 每一个都作为波来传播,干扰自己, 被检测一次,作为一个粒子,在一个像素上。 分解模式是这些探测器的直方图. 它的预期值是波的强度,而其波动正在计算出噪音.

blocks.en: Specimen, layer by layer. Each atom’s electrostatic potential (a positive nucleus screened by its electron cloud) slows the electron and shifts the phase of its wave. A thin layer acts as a phase screen. Between layers the wave spreads by Fresnel diffraction. In a thin bilayer the electron is scattered a few times. In a crystal many depths of field thick, it is scattered many times and channels along atomic columns. Multislice alternates the two steps, transmit and propagate ( Eq. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 相克相克,相克相克. 每个原子的静电潜能(被其电子云所筛选出的一个正核)会使电子变慢并改变其波的相. 薄层起到相相屏的作用. 在地层之间,波由弗雷斯内尔分流传播. 在薄的双层电子中,电子被分散了好几次. 在晶体多深的地段厚度下,它会分出多次并沿着原子柱而行道. multislice 替代了两个步骤,即传送和传播(Eq. 4)。

blocks.en: Heat. At room temperature the atoms vibrate by a few picometers, with periods of about a picosecond. An electron crosses the specimen in about 10 − 17 10^{-17} s, so it sees the atoms frozen in one configuration. Successive electrons see different configurations. The recorded pattern is therefore an average of intensities over thermal configurations ( Eq. 12 ). That average weakens the sharp diffraction and spreads intensity to high angles (thermal diffuse scattering). A few electrons also lose energy to the specimen (inelastic scattering), which redistributes them by small angles.
blocks.zh: 发热. 在室温下,原子会由几相相计振动,时长约为一相相相相相. 一个电子在大约10−17 10^{-17} s中穿过了标本,所以它看到原子在一个构型中被冻结. 相继出现的电子会看到不同的配置. 因此,记录的形态是平均强度高于热能配置(Eq. 12.). 这一平均值会削弱尖锐的疏松并扩散到高角度(热扩散散射)。 少数电子也失去能量给标本(无弹性散射),由小角度再生.

blocks.en: Detector. After the specimen, the pattern spreads over the camera length onto a pixelated detector. On the EMPAD, each electron deposits its energy in silicon. The charge spreads sideways, by an amount that grows with beam energy, into neighboring pixels, and each pixel integrates its charge over its area and the frame time. The readout converts charge to a number through a gain (151 ADU per electron at 80 kV), and a dark frame is subtracted. The recorded value is thus a blurred, integrated, scaled count with a little read noise ( Eq. 14 ).
blocks.zh: 探测器。 标本后,图案会从相机长度上传播到像素探测器上. 在EMPAD上,每个电子都以硅来储存能量. 电荷会散开侧道,用能随光束能量而增长的量,形成相邻的像素,而每个像素会将它的电荷融入到其区域和帧时间上. 读出后通过增益(每个电子有151个ADU,以80千伏计)转换出电荷为数字,并减去一个暗框. 因此,记录值是一个模糊、综合、有小读噪声的缩放计数(Eq. 14)。

blocks.en: Dose. Dose is the number of electrons per unit area, in electrons per Å 2 . Beam-sensitive specimens are damaged above a threshold dose, so they are imaged at low dose. There most dark-field detector pixels record zero or one electron (median 0.35 on the bilayer). Poisson counting noise then sets what can be learned. At high dose the counts per pixel are large, the noise is nearly Gaussian, and errors in the model, not counting noise, set the limit (§S2). Because electrons arrive independently, the count in each pixel is a Poisson variable whose mean is the model’s expected count. The natural loss is therefore the Poisson negative log-likelihood of the counts, which weights each pixel by its noise, rather than least squares or L1 on intensities (§S2).
blocks.zh: dose. dose是单位面积电子数,以每 2电子为单位. 光束敏感的标本被损坏在阈值剂量以上,因此在低剂量下被成像. 有大多数暗地探测器像素记录为0或1个电子(中间值为0.35在双层上). Poisson计算噪音,然后确定可以学到的东西。 在高剂量时,每个像素的计数是很大的,噪声接近高斯语,模型中的错误,不计出噪声,设定了极限(§S2). 由于电子是独立运出,每个像素中的计数是一个Poisson变量,其平均值是模型的预期计数. 因此,自然损失是计数的普瓦生负向日志相仿,它通过每个像素的噪声来加权,而不是在强度上最小的平方或L1(§S2).

blocks.en: The scan. The probe steps across the specimen on a grid finer than its width, so neighboring illuminated regions overlap. One pattern is recorded at each position. The overlap makes ptychography possible. The forward model of § 3 follows this path in order: source and probe, multislice through vibrating atoms, the detector, and the Poisson likelihood of the counts.
blocks.zh: 扫描 探测器在比其宽度更细的网格上跨出标本,所以相邻被照亮的区域相重叠. 每个位置记录一个模式。 重叠使得平面图成为可能. 第3节的前向模型依次遵循了这个路径:出自和探测器,通过振动原子进行多切片,探测器,以及计数的普瓦森概率.

blocks.en: S1. Model components
blocks.zh: S1. 模型组件

blocks.en:
We test the object (atoms, pixels or a hybrid), the thermal model (frozen phonons with K K = 1 to 32, mean field, absorptive potential), partial coherence and focal spread, aberration order, slicing, the depth-placement kernel, and the exact Foldy–Lax reference. • Exact reference: atom-by-atom Foldy–Lax multiple scattering with partial-wave T-matrices; back-scattering below 10 − 14 10^{-14} for the tabulated potential, forward-only equals full to 3 × 10 − 13 3\times 10^{-13} (§S18). • Forward-only Foldy–Lax is multislice with one atom per slice, which links the reference to the fitted model (§S18). • Partial waves agree with ELSEPA to 10 − 4 10^{-4} ; the tabulated potential [ 50 ] differs from it by + 1.6 % +1.6\% to − 4.8 % -4.8\% (80–300 kV). • 1 Å slice grid: tungsten (W) dark-field amplitude error 3.3% (selenium, Se, 1.0%); plane-aligned or ≤ 0.25 \leq 0.25 Å slices: ≤ 1 % \leq 1\% ; with the eikonal-exact phase: ≤ 0.3 % \leq 0.3\% . These hold for mean-field atoms at the reference sampling. Static atoms are in §S18. • Probe window: agreement with abTEM 1.1% at 50 Å (dark field 4.8%), against 4.3% at 25 Å. • With point-sampled detector pixels, mean field and frozen phonons ( K = 32 K=32 ) predict the held-out patterns equally well within noise. Each is fitted from two starts and scored on the 128 held-out patterns with a freshly computed probe-mode basis on common configurations. Paired per pattern, the frozen-phonon D H D_{H} differs from the mean field’s by ( + 4.1 ± 3.1 ) × 10 − 4 (+4.1\pm 3.1)\times 10^{-4} per pixel from one start and ( − 4.4 ± 3.6 ) × 10 − 4 (-4.4\pm 3.6)\times 10^{-4} from the other. The two starts fit the same counts, so they are not pooled as independent samples. The standard errors treat the 128 patterns as independent. Neighboring held-out patterns are 1.2 Å apart and share atom misfit, so the standard errors are lower bounds.
The score is converged in K K ( K = 64 K=64 changes it by 10 − 5 10^{-5} ). • A third thermal model keeps the mean field and adds the absorptive phase 1 2 ​ σ 2 ​ Var ϵ ​ [ v ] \tfrac{1}{2}\sigma^{2}\operatorname{Var}_{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}[v] , the second cumulant of the frozen-phonon phase [ 20 ] , in closed form for Gaussian terms. • The absorptive potential is worse by 0.0012 per pixel, 4.9 times its paired standard error, because it removes flux that the detector records as thermal diffuse scattering. • The two thermal models differ in their widths. Frozen phonons give U a \sqrt{U_{a}} = 7.35 pm for W and 8.97–8.98 pm for Se (two starts). These effective widths exceed the ≈ \approx 5.5 pm molecular-dynamics value because static displacements, vacancies and drift add to thermal motion ( § 5.3 ).
The propagation distance Δ ​ z \Delta z between the two W slices of the six-plane model (one slice per atomic plane, the Se planes fixed at ± 1.67 \pm 1.67 Å from their W plane) is 6.74 Å from both starts. Δ ​ z \Delta z is a parameter of that model, not the interlayer spacing. Its Fisher standard deviation is 0.013 Å. Its offset from the nominal 6.5 Å spacing is 0.24 Å, only 0.0036 depths of field. With depth-resolved atoms and no priors, the W–W spacing is 6.51 Å on the published 6 ∘ bilayer and 6.62 Å on the simulation (truth 6.60 Å; §S15). In that comparison the mean field reaches the same prediction only with U a \sqrt{U_{a}} = 11.3–11.4 pm for W, twice the molecular-dynamics value, a collapsed 1.4 pm for Se, and Δ ​ z \Delta z = 6.40–6.43 Å.
The mean field suffices to predict a thin bilayer. The thermal widths require frozen phonons. Image-based thermometry on twisted-bilayer molybdenum disulfide (MoS 2 ) under the same acquisition conditions (80 kV, 25 mrad, EMPAD) finds room-temperature rms displacements of about 9.6 pm for Mo and 11.7 pm for S, with 1–2 pm precision per atom [ 2 ] ; W and Se are heavier. The bounds of § 5 are 0.7–1.4 pm per atom. On the counts before the dark-reference correction (§S14), the widths are converged in K K to 0.1 pm: fits with K = 8 K=8 and K = 32 K=32 give W 5.17 against 5.21 pm and Se 5.07 against 5.08 pm from one start, and 5.39 against 5.49 pm and 4.96 against 4.97 pm from the other. • The atom model trails a free-pixel fit by 0.047 per pixel ( Tab. 2 ), far more than the phonon effect, so the thermal model does not set the remaining deficit.
The thick specimens (PdH, PrScO 3 ) are fitted with a pixel object only (§S10), so the thermal model is untested there. • Representation size. An atom carries four parameters (three in a layered specimen), so the 25 mrad bilayer needs 2.6 per Å 2 , against 26 real values per Å 2 for our one-slice pixel fit and 208 for a four-slice complex object ( § 3 ). Over its scanned field, 1,985 atoms carry 7,940 parameters. For the thick PdH particle a pixel object of 14 slices holds 1.0 × 10 7 1.0\times 10^{7} complex values, plus free probe modes. • Depth derivatives need a placement kernel of fixed physical width. Placing an atom on the two nearest depth nodes (linear weights) gives a correct forward model. Each atom is therefore a 3D object of depth extent σ z ≪ λ / ϑ max 2 \sigma_{z}\ll\lambda/\vartheta_{\max}^{2} that moves rigidly. The two thermal models differ in their widths. Frozen phonons give U a \sqrt{U_{a}} = 7.35 pm for W and 8.97–8.98 pm for Se (two starts). These effective widths exceed the ≈ \approx 5.5 pm molecular-dynamics value because static displacements, vacancies and drift add to thermal motion ( § 5.3 ).
The propagation distance Δ ​ z \Delta z between the two W slices of the six-plane model (one slice per atomic plane, the Se planes fixed at ± 1.67 \pm 1.67 Å from their W plane) is 6.74 Å from both starts. Δ ​ z \Delta z is a parameter of that model, not the interlayer spacing. Its Fisher standard deviation is 0.013 Å. Its offset from the nominal 6.5 Å spacing is 0.24 Å, only 0.0036 depths of field. With depth-resolved atoms and no priors, the W–W spacing is 6.51 Å on the published 6 ∘ bilayer and 6.62 Å on the simulation (truth 6.60 Å; §S15). In that comparison the mean field reaches the same prediction only with U a \sqrt{U_{a}} = 11.3–11.4 pm for W, twice the molecular-dynamics value, a collapsed 1.4 pm for Se, and Δ ​ z \Delta z = 6.40–6.43 Å.
The mean field suffices to predict a thin bilayer. The thermal widths require frozen phonons. Image-based thermometry on twisted-bilayer molybdenum disulfide (MoS 2 ) under the same acquisition conditions (80 kV, 25 mrad, EMPAD) finds room-temperature rms displacements of about 9.6 pm for Mo and 11.7 pm for S, with 1–2 pm precision per atom [ 2 ] ; W and Se are heavier. The bounds of § 5 are 0.7–1.4 pm per atom. On the counts before the dark-reference correction (§S14), the widths are converged in K K to 0.1 pm: fits with K = 8 K=8 and K = 32 K=32 give W 5.17 against 5.21 pm and Se 5.07 against 5.08 pm from one start, and 5.39 against 5.49 pm and 4.96 against 4.97 pm from the other.

blocks.en: We compare the Poisson likelihood with least squares on counts and on amplitudes, for the same model, data and held-out set. blocks.en: Tab. S2 trains our pixel solver, unchanged, under four losses on three datasets, with only the loss swapped (Poisson path bit-identical). The PrScO 3 and PZT values imply effective gains 25–45% below the nominal ones.

blocks.en: This test checks the estimator and its bars under a correct model. It draws Poisson counts from the fitted model at the measured dose (a redraw) and refits each from the generating point with the same objective. Model error is tested in §§S6 and S15. ζ = ( θ ^ k − θ k true ) / sd \zeta=(\hat{\theta}_{k}-\theta_{k}^{\mathrm{true}})/\mathrm{sd} uses the Fisher standard deviation at the truth. blocks.en: Synthetic (twisted bilayer at the conditions of the 25 mrad data; instrument fitted jointly). The model has 1,985 atoms with position and in-plane covariance (six parameters each) and 16 instrument parameters ( Δ ​ f \Delta f , 𝐀 1 \mathbf{A}_{1} , 𝐀 2 \mathbf{A}_{2} , 𝐁 2 \mathbf{B}_{2} , C s C_{s} , σ d \sigma_{d} , η \eta , a four-term scan affine map, σ f \sigma_{f} , σ src \sigma_{\mathrm{src}} ), 11,926 in all. The Fisher matrix costs about 1,500 CPU core-hours. It is assembled in blocks of nearby positions truncated at 6 Å: 2–3% of the diagonal information of a tungsten (W) atom lies beyond, and the truncation changes those bounds by about 1%. Doses are 5.2 × 10 5 5.2\times 10^{5} e/Å 2 , with 2.4 × 10 5 2.4\times 10^{5} in brackets. • Single atom, sd( U a \sqrt{U_{a}} ): W 0.14 pm [0.21]; Se 0.43 pm [0.65]. • Region means of U a \sqrt{U_{a}} : sd 0.006–0.014 pm. AA and AB stacking are resolved at 65 sd [44]. • Domain-wall phason ellipse (1.3:1), single W atom: detected at 4.5 sd, orientation to 6 ∘ [9 ∘ ]. • Identifiability: | r | ≤ 0.042 |r|\leq 0.042 with every instrument parameter. Fitting the instrument jointly widens the bounds by < 0.3 % <0.3\% . • Recovery on synthetic refits: empirical over predicted spread 0.88–0.99; χ 2 \chi^{2} 0.93–1.12 (1 dof). • The bounds are 20–50 × \times below published image-fitting errors. Real data (Laplace bounds at the fitted optimum, conditional on the model). • Public data, 10.3 mrad, atom model: – Columns resolved from the other layer by more than 1 Å (0.41 λ / α \lambda/\alpha ) have median U U = 0.0062 Å 2 ( U \sqrt{U} = 7.9 pm) for both W and Se 2 . – Pairs closer than 0.4 Å (108 of 282 interior sites) merge into one broad column and are flagged. – The W and Se 2 sublattices are not distinguished at this aperture, so per-site U U is an effective column width. • Main dataset, 25 mrad [ 69 ] , the main real-data result. Frozen phonons, K = 32 K=32 : – Species widths with the instrument profiled: U \sqrt{U} = 7.35 ± \pm 0.03 pm (W) and 8.98 ± \pm 0.04 pm (Se) at the converged fit (Laplace bars, dense K = 8 K=8 Fisher information over the 502 non-offset parameters of the species-width model, with the offsets eliminated; the per-atom plan of §§S12 and S16 has 1,636 columns). With the instrument known the bars are 0.033 and 0.039 pm. From the data term alone, without the priors, they are 0.034 and 0.041 pm. The cluster-by-pattern sandwich bars are 0.15 and 0.13 pm, 4.5 and 3.2 times the Laplace bars. The species-width model is therefore misspecified at this level; the per-atom misfit of §S3 is the likely carrier. The Pearson dispersion of the training counts at this fit is 0.92. – Per-atom widths for the 236 interior atoms: median sd( U a \sqrt{U_{a}} ) 0.68 pm (W) and 1.36 pm (Se), from the per-atom Fisher information at the converged species-width fit. – All Fisher bars on the 25 mrad data use K = 8 K=8 of the fit’s 32 phonon configurations. Their medians hold to about 10%; the bar of a single atom depends on its four antithetic pairs of draws. The per-atom position bars have medians of 0.5 pm (W) and 0.8 pm (Se) ( Fig. 1 ). – Region means (78 W, 158 Se): sd 0.23 and 0.76 pm. – Correlation with every instrument parameter: | r | ≤ 0.07 |r|\leq 0.07 (W; 0.02 for Se). – The real per-atom bounds are 3–5 × \times the synthetic ones (0.68 against 0.14 pm for W, 1.36 against 0.43 pm for Se). Most of the gap is accounted for (§S12). Thermal diffuse scattering leaves frozen-phonon intensities with 3.9 times less diagonal width information for W (1.3 for Se) than the static potential of the synthetic test. The 71 mrad scoring disc keeps 58% of the detector’s information, and marginalizing the neighbors costs a further factor of 1.3–1.4. The rest is the per-atom misfit, measured at the budget fit (§S12) at 3.5 sd (W) and 3.4 sd (Se) against the 2.0 and 1.3 sd that the budgeted terms explain there. The width map after 40 iterations of the per-atom refit is Fig. S1 (§S3). • Held-out comparison on the same data: the 128 held-out patterns of one 32 × 32 32\times 32 sub-scan, identical counts and scoring (exact detector-pixel integration, Tab. 2 ). – Our free-mode pixel fit (8 modes, one slice): D H D_{H} 0.4025, gap 0.027. – PtyRAD at its published settings, retrained without the held-out patterns: 0.4817 (full field, gap 0.014); 0.4735 trained on the sub-scan alone (gap 0.012). – Our atom model (frozen phonons, K = 32 K=32 , one width per species): 0.4496, gap 0.005; 0.4312 with the calibrated detector ellipse (§S14). – Our pixel fit leads PtyRAD by 0.071–0.079 per pixel. The atom model is 0.047 per pixel behind (0.029 with the ellipse), returns physical parameters with error bars, and has the smallest train–test gap. – fold_slice at its published schedule (400 + 125 iterations), retrained without the held-out patterns: 0.4552, gap 0.007.

blocks.en: The species-width fit is run from two starts. In projection, the tungsten atoms of the two layers can trade places where their columns coincide, and so can the two selenium atoms of one column. Such a relabeling barely changes the counts, so two starts can differ by a few of these discrete swaps. An exchange screen and a relaxed exchange test remove them (§S17), after which the two starts agree inside the scan box. Of the 236 free atoms, 232 agree to better than 0.1 Å (median 0.04 pm; 0.05 pm rms for the 114 inside the box), and the species widths agree to 0.001 and 0.010 pm (0.04 and 0.24 sd). The other four are selenium atoms in the margin, 1.6–4.9 Å outside the scan box. Their Fisher standard deviations, 0.017–0.17 Å, are 3–26 times the median inside the box (0.0066 Å). Yet the two starts place them 0.28–3.4 Å apart. They sit in different local arrangements, which a local bound does not describe. The rearrangement is worth at most 28 nats of the training objective. It does not move the reported widths.
blocks.zh: 物种-宽合从两个起跑. 在投影中,两层的钨原子可以交换其柱子相通的地方,而一柱的两个硒原子也可以交换. 这样的再贴标签几乎不会改变计数,因此两个起算点可能会因其中几个独立的互换而不同. 一个交换屏幕和一个放松的交换测试去掉它们(§S17),之后两个开始在扫描盒内达成一致. 在236个自由原子中,232个同意优于0.1 Å (中位数为0.04平方公分;箱内114个为0.05平方公分),物种宽度同意为0.001平方公分和0.010平方公分(0.04平方公分和0.24平方公分). 其他四个是边距中的硒原子,1.6–4.9 Å 在扫描盒外. 其渔业标准差,0.017-0.17 箱内中位数的3-26倍(0.0066)。 然而,两个开始放在0.28 -3.4 分开。 它们坐落在不同的地方安排中,地方约束没有加以描述。 重新安排最多值28纳特的培训目标。 它不移动报告的宽度。

blocks.en: To test whether the fit recovers or creates the Se-pair splits, we simulate data from known structures with an independent multislice code ( abTEM : Lobato potentials, 0.25 Å slices, 3D frozen phonons, exact pixel integration). The simulation uses the fitted instrument, dose, scan and held-out split of the real data, on the central 16 × 16 16\times 16 positions. Our pipeline fits it from the tied start. • Coincident Se pairs: release gives splits of median 0.017 Å (0.010 λ / α \lambda/\alpha ), a gain of 8 nats against 9 expected by chance, and no held-out improvement. The result is the same with an anisotropic thermal ellipsoid and a ± \pm 10% width at each site (0.017 Å), and with DFT bonding charge in the potential (0.013 Å). • Planted splits of 0.05–0.20 Å in random directions are all detected (7 of 7, no false detection among the null pairs), with median vector error 0.016 Å and median angle error 9 ∘ . The release gains 58 nats per split pair and lowers the held-out deviance by 2.7 × 10 − 4 2.7\times 10^{-4} per pixel. The Fisher bars of the split components understate the scatter by a factor of 1.5–2. • Outer-plane Se vacancies leave a different signature. The remaining atom of the column moves by about 0.6 Å, worth about 2,000 nats. • At an earlier fit, the real data give in-box splits of median 0.10 Å (at most 0.28 Å), about 63 nats per pair and a held-out improvement of 8 × 10 − 4 8\times 10^{-4} per pixel. This matches the planted case and none of the confounds. Not tested: dislocations, Se buckling along the beam, larger site anisotropy, interstitials. • The same test bounds the accuracy of the species widths. Against a sampling-converged simulation the fitted U \sqrt{U} are low by 0.9 pm (W) and 0.75 pm (Se), 8–12%, because our forward model under-predicts dark-field intensity by 3–7% (static cores without the Coulomb cusp, the 2.55 Å -1 band limit, plane slicing). The fit compensates with a smaller U U and a higher background. On data from our model the pipeline recovers the widths to within 1.4 error bars. Coherence, vibration along the beam, the scattering-factor table, bonding and the number of phonon configurations are each excluded as causes.

blocks.en: The same synthetic bilayer is redrawn at fractions ρ \rho = 1, 1/2, 1/4 and 1/8 of the measured dose. As in §S4, only refits that reach the convergence test are scored (42, 47, 44 and 23 draws; at ρ = 1 / 8 \rho=1/8 the rest stop on the iteration budget or the FP32 line-search floor). blocks.en: The fit separates the two layers and places each atomic plane without structural priors: the W–W spacing comes out at 6.62 Å against the true 6.60 Å (§S15). From the published reconstruction, with depth polished to the likelihood minimum, depth error is 49 pm rms (W 50, Se 49 pm), against 114 pm for the 3D phase peaks. Freeing in-plane positions as well leaves it at 51 pm. The Fisher bound on single-atom depth is 8 pm, about what flat tilted layers give, and the likelihood of one atom’s depth has that width ( Fig. S3 ). Mismatch between our model and the simulator (0.02–0.035 per pixel in D H D_{H} ) places these minima tens of picometers from truth. The items below give the evidence. • Task: recover ( x , y , z , U ) (x,y,z,U) for every atom of the simulated bilayer, with no bond-length or interlayer prior; a weak Gaussian prior (0.5 Å) acts on in-plane position increments only, none on depth. Two starts: – (i) From the published reconstruction (main text): in-plane, the 3-D phase peaks; in depth, one plane fitted to the peak depths of each layer. Truth enters only through one global similarity (four numbers), the depth gauge and atom identity. Start error: 4.9 pm in-plane, 47 pm in depth. – (ii) With the true layer geometry: flat layers at the true tilt and depth, so no per-atom depth information, and in-plane offsets of about 14 pm rms from truth. Start error in depth: 11–12 pm. • Instrument: fitted jointly. The simulation is coherent, so the fitted focal spread and source size measure how far our model departs from the simulator. • Fit floor at the true atoms: with the instrument fitted, D H = 0.384 D_{H}=0.384 , against a Poisson floor of 0.35–0.36 for our model. – The difference, 0.02–0.035 per pixel, is the model mismatch between their simulator and ours (potential parameterization, slicing, detector binning). • References for depth error (rms over atoms): – peaks of the published multislice reconstruction, 84 pm (W) and 127 pm (Se); – the same after bond-length and interlayer priors, 5.3 pm [ 22 ] ; – flat tilted planes fitted to the truth, which carry no per-atom depth information, 6.3–6.5 pm per plane. Per-atom depth resolution therefore requires an error below about 6.4 pm, about 10 − 3 10^{-3} of the depth of field. • Block test: 48 × 48 48\times 48 positions (20.6 Å = 12 λ / α \lambda/\alpha square; 266 atoms inside the window, all free): – Start: flat layers at the true tilt; in-plane offsets of 13.5 pm rms; depth offsets of 10.9 pm rms. – Held-out D H D_{H} is 0.3842, with gap D H − D T D_{H}-D_{T} = 0.0008. Both are within 0.001 of the fit at the true atoms. – Fit time 2.8 h on one consumer GPU. • In-plane positions on this block are recovered to 3.75 pm rms ( 2.2 × 10 − 2 ​ λ / α 2.2\times 10^{-2}\,\lambda/\alpha ; W 3.65 pm, Se 3.80 pm), with no structural priors (3.2 pm over the full field below). Huang et al . reach 4.4 pm using bond-length and interlayer priors [ 22 ] . • At convergence, counting statistics and the model set depth: – Fisher bound on per-atom depth, instrument profiled: 8.0 pm rms ( 1.2 × 10 − 3 ​ λ / α 2 1.2\times 10^{-3}\,\lambda/\alpha^{2} ; W 6.7 pm, Se 8.6 pm). This is about the 6.4 pm that flat tilted planes give. At 6 × 10 5 6\times 10^{5} electrons per resolution cell, the data alone cannot locate single atoms in depth much better than the layer geometry does. The 5.3 pm of Huang et al . is below this bound because their bond-length and interlayer priors supply the missing information. – The joint fit stays at 11.2 pm, 1.44 bound-sd per atom, with 85% of atoms inside 2 sd. – A depth-only search with the instrument and in-plane positions held at the joint fit lands at the same point from either start, the fit or the true depths. That point is 36.6 pm rms from the truth, at a lower objective ( D H D_{H} 0.38387 against 0.38418). The true depths are not a stationary point of our objective. – Rescaling depth steps by 10 × \times in the joint fit gives 17.1 pm at a similar objective ( D H D_{H} 0.38393). The next steps are structural priors and a potential matched to the simulator. • In-plane, the same mismatch dominates: the bound is 0.33 pm, against the block error of 3.75 pm. • Widths: the 25 mrad fits use log ⁡ U \log U , so U > 0 U>0 by construction ( § 3 ). The simulated truth has U = 0 U=0 , on the boundary, so these fits use U U directly, bounded below at − 3 -3 pm 2 , to test for bias at zero. • Width at zero truth: W U = − 1.5 ± 4.9 U=-1.5\pm 4.9 pm 2 (bound 1.8 pm 2 ), unbiased. Se is biased by + 12.5 +12.5 pm 2 (bound 4.7 pm 2 ), consistent with the Se 2 column absorbing the depth and potential mismatch. • Full field from start (i): 128 × 128 128\times 128 positions, all 1,928 atoms in the window free; 14 h on one RTX A6000. – D H D_{H} 0.38403. – In-plane: 3.2 pm rms (W 2.8 pm, Se 3.4 pm), without priors, from 4.9 pm at the start. – Depth: 35.8 pm rms (W 29.0, Se 38.8 pm) at the full fit, 49.0 pm (W 49.6, Se 48.8 pm) with depth polished to the likelihood minimum, and 50.9 pm (W 51.3, Se 50.7 pm) after a joint polish of x x , y y and z z (below). The block’s depth-only searches end at a similar distance, 36.6 pm. The fit from start (ii) has held-out D H D_{H} lower by 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , so the counts separate the two depth configurations only weakly. • Full field from start (ii), the same flags; 14 h on one RTX A5000. In-plane agrees with start (i) to 0.05 pm. Depth starts at 12.1 pm and ends at 16.7 pm. This fit has no depth polish, so its depth stays near the start. – D H D_{H} 0.38384, gap 0.0003. – In-plane: 3.20 pm rms ( 1.9 × 10 − 2 ​ λ / α 1.9\times 10^{-2}\,\lambda/\alpha ; W 2.9 pm, Se 3.4 pm), without priors. – Depth: 16.7 pm rms. Whole atomic planes shift by − 13.5 -13.5 to + 8.5 +8.5 pm, so the mismatch acts on the layer geometry as much as on single atoms. – Widths: W sits near the lower bound of U U ( − 3 -3 pm 2 ; mean 0.5 pm 2 ), and Se is biased by + 47 +47 pm 2 . The same mismatch causes both. – Fisher bounds on the full field (9,495 parameters, instrument profiled): depth 8.2 pm rms (W 6.6, Se 8.9 pm), the same as on the block; in-plane 0.34 pm. The errors are 2.2 bound-sd in depth and 10 in-plane, with whole planes shifted by − 13.5 -13.5 to + 8.5 +8.5 pm. Width bounds: 1.8 pm 2 (W) and 5.2 pm 2 (Se). • Sensitivity to the depth profile: σ z \sigma_{z} = 0.25, 0.4 and 0.6 Å give the same depth error (11.2, 11.2 and 11.1 pm) and in-plane error (3.67, 3.75 and 3.98 pm). D H D_{H} is 0.3835, 0.3842 and 0.3851, so the narrowest profile fits best. • Freezing focal spread and source size near 0 on these coherent data leaves depth at 11.1 pm and costs 0.017 per pixel in D H D_{H} . The fitted partial coherence absorbs the simulator mismatch; it does not limit depth. • Fig. S2 shows the per-atom depth errors of the full field against their bounds. • One-atom depth profiles at the fit from start (i), all other parameters fixed (three W and three Se atoms, interior; Fig. S3 a). The training likelihood is 4.8–5.3 pm wide for W and 7.5–9.0 pm for Se, against Fisher standard deviations of 5.8–6.5 and 8.4–8.8 pm, so the counts locate a single atom in depth at the bound. At the full fit each minimum lies 20–70 pm away, 4–35 nats lower, and the held-out deviance falls in the same direction. A depth-only L-BFGS polish of all in-window atoms, run to a relative decrease below 10 − 7 10^{-7} , moves them toward the minima by 56 pm rms: D H D_{H} falls from 0.38403 to 0.38364, depth error is 49.6 / 48.8 pm (W / Se), and in-plane is unchanged. A joint polish of x x , y y and z z from there lowers D H D_{H} to 0.38360 and leaves depth at 51.3 / 50.7 pm and in-plane at 3.2 pm. The minima lie 14–51 pm from truth, the model mismatch above. • An x ​ z xz section through both layers ( Fig. S3 b,c): the fitted atoms show the two layers and their Se planes; the published multislice reconstruction of the same data shows streaks along the beam, its depth of field λ / α 2 = 67 \lambda/\alpha^{2}=67 Å being 10 × 10\times the layer spacing.

blocks.en: One-atom depth profiles at the fit from start (i), all other parameters fixed (three W and three Se atoms, interior; Fig. S3 a). The training likelihood is 4.8–5.3 pm wide for W and 7.5–9.0 pm for Se, against Fisher standard deviations of 5.8–6.5 and 8.4–8.8 pm, so the counts locate a single atom in depth at the bound. At the full fit each minimum lies 20–70 pm away, 4–35 nats lower, and the held-out deviance falls in the same direction. A depth-only L-BFGS polish of all in-window atoms, run to a relative decrease below 10 − 7 10^{-7} , moves them toward the minima by 56 pm rms: D H D_{H} falls from 0.38403 to 0.38364, depth error is 49.6 / 48.8 pm (W / Se), and in-plane is unchanged. A joint polish of x x , y y and z z from there lowers D H D_{H} to 0.38360 and leaves depth at 51.3 / 50.7 pm and in-plane at 3.2 pm. The minima lie 14–51 pm from truth, the model mismatch above.

blocks.en: S7. Held-out protocol
blocks.zh: S7. 淘汰协议

blocks.en: One pattern in eight is held out by the rule ( j 1 + 3 ​ j 2 ) mod 8 = 0 (j_{1}+3j_{2})\bmod 8=0 on the scan grid. Held-out positions come from their scan neighbors (neighbor rule). Deviance is scored on the 2/3 disc. A floor of 10 − 9 10^{-9} in the model intensity changes scores by 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Baselines train only on the remaining seven eighths, in every stage, and are scored on the same 128 (sub-scan) or 2,048 (full field) patterns through our likelihood.

blocks.en: Our pixel solver fits a Gaussian detector blur σ \sigma (clamped to [0.05, 3] px). Freezing it measures its effect (4 modes, three seeds, full depth, same held-out rule, 1,336 s each on one RTX A4000): blur D H ↓ D_{H}\!\downarrow gap σ \sigma (px) fitted 0.4224 ± \pm 0.0006 0.131 0.862 pinned at the hardware value 0.4766 ± \pm 0.0004 0.105 1.34 off 0.4927 ± \pm 0.0023 0.153 0.05 • The fitted blur is worth 0.070 per pixel. Without it, our fit trails PtyRAD (0.4877 at 1,000 and 0.4846 at 4,000 iterations) by 0.005–0.008. PtyRAD also applies a blur kernel, so the margin comes from fitting the blur width with the specimen. • The data reject the per-axis charge spread measured for the EMPAD-G2 at 300 keV (201 μ \mu m [ 51 ] , 1.34 px at 150 μ \mu m pixels): pinning it costs 0.054. The fitted 0.86 px is an effective blur after the free modes take their share (below). • One run suggests that free modes absorb detector blur. On the 7-slice first stage (seed 1), removing the blur costs 0.151 with four modes and 0.092 with eight. The fitted blur falls from 0.81 to 0.66 px (0.86 to 0.79 px at full depth; 0.91 to 0.70 px on PZT). The difference, 0.059, is twenty times the spread over seeds and GPUs. This is consistent with Fig. 2 . A full-depth check with eight modes needs a card with more than 16 GB.

blocks.en: PtyRANNOSAUR is a learned reconstructor. Convolutional networks trained on multislice simulations of Materials Project structures map patches of diffraction patterns to a real projected phase [ 38 ] . Three properties keep it out of Tab. 2 . • Its models hold only at their training conditions: 80 kV, 25 mrad and 2 ± 0.6 2\pm 0.6 nm; and 300 kV, 25 mrad, 10 ± 2 10\pm 2 or 20 ± 2 20\pm 2 nm, with defocus of 5–7.5 nm and a 0.5 Å step. Its authors note that accuracy decreases outside these regimes. Our bilayer is at the conditions of the first. PrScO 3 (21.4 mrad, 20 nm defocus), PZT (200 kV) and PdH (30 mrad, 28 nm) are not, and on our 18.4 mrad data the network fails (above). A fair comparison there needs a model retrained at each dataset’s conditions, about 64 A100-hours each by its authors’ account, with training choices that would be ours, not theirs. • It returns a real projected phase, not a complex multislice object with a probe, scan and coherence, so it cannot predict a diffraction pattern by itself. We score it through our fitted instrument, with and without a fitted global scale. • Its paper validates by SSIM against simulated truth and by comparison with an iterative reconstruction. No held-out score is reported on experimental data. Where it applies, it is fast and close: 0.419 against 0.409 for our free-mode fit, from 5 s of inference. As a warm start it makes our fit 3.1 × \times faster. Our fit adds the instrument and the error bars. We therefore treat it as a learned warm start that our method refines. Its speed suits further roles, not tested here: • live view during acquisition, with the FI evaluated at its output to choose the next scan positions and dose (§S16); • an initial atom list, by peak finding on its phase, for the atom model; • training once over the range of instrument states a calibration scan reports (probe, coherence and detector blur), which would remove the retraining per condition; • triage of large fields: regions where its output and a fit disagree, or its held-out deviance is high, get a full fit. The same score flags structure imported from training data.
blocks.zh: Ptyrannosaur是一个有学问的重建者。 接受过材料多切片模拟培训的革命网络项目结构图将分解模式的补丁映射到真正的预测阶段[38]. 三自性出取出塔布. ● 其型号只在训练条件下维持:80千伏、25克雷德和2±0.6平方厘米;300克雷德、25克雷德、10±2平方厘米、10±2平方厘米2或20±2平方厘米,分焦为5-7.5纳米并有0.5分步。 作者指出,在这些制度之外,准确性下降。 我们的双层分子处于第一层的条件。 PrScO 3 (21.4 Mrad, 20 nm de focus), PZT (200 kV)和PdH (30 Mrad, 28 nm)不是, 在我们的18.4 Mrad数据上,网络失败了(上). 一个公平的比较需要在每个数据集的条件上重新培训一个模型,由作者的账户计算,每个模型大约64 A100小时,培训选择将是我们的,而不是他们的。 它返回一个真实的被预测相,而不是一个带有探针,扫描和一致性的复杂的多切片对象,因此它无法自己预测出一个疏松模式. 我们用我们配有的仪器来评分,无论有无配有的全球尺度。 二. 支助 它的论文通过SSIM验证模拟真理,并与迭代重建作比较. 实验数据中未报告搁置得分。 在适用的情况下,它是快而相近的:从5个推论来看,我们的自由模式适合0.419和0.409。 作为温暖的起步 它让我们的合身 3.1 × 时间更快。 我们的配位增加了仪器和出错栏 因此,我们把它视为我们的方法不断完善的一个学习到的温暖开端。 其速度适合进一步的作用,在此没有测试: • 获取期间现场查看,FI在输出时评价其选择下一个扫描位置和剂量(§S16); • 初始原子清单,按其相位时的峰值发现,用于原子模型; • 仪器范围的培训一次说明校准扫描报告(probe,一致性和探测器模糊),这将取消每个条件的再培训; • 对大字段的分解:其输出和适配度不均的区域,或其阻滞偏差高的区域,获得完全适配. 从训练数据导入的同分旗结构.

blocks.en: Diederichs et al . released their code ( torchslice ) with a pixel-object notebook for the PrScO 3 data of Tab. 2 [ 11 ] ; their PZT atom pipeline is not released. We convert the notebook to a script and change only two things: the held-out patterns leave the epoch loop, and the snapshots are saved. The intensity scale (mean total per pattern) uses training patterns only. • Model as released: 40 complex phase gratings of 5 Å on a 512 2 512^{2} grid at 0.093 Å ( 0.10 ​ λ / α 0.10\,\lambda/\alpha , half our pixel), 13 spatial and 1 temporal coherence states with fitted weights and offsets, five aberrations, per-pattern positions; about 2.1 × 10 7 2.1\times 10^{7} parameters (ours with 4 modes: 7.6 × 10 6 7.6\times 10^{6} ). Adam with their four learning rates, warm-up and switch-on epochs and halving on a worse epoch, one step per pattern, 50 epochs, L1 on intensities over the whole 256 2 256^{2} frame, sparse-frequency regularizer. • Our loss: only L1 ⋅ 10 6 \mathrm{L1}\cdot 10^{6} is replaced by c ​ ∑ [ λ − n + n ​ log ⁡ ( n / λ ) ] c\sum[\lambda-n+n\log(n/\lambda)] with λ \lambda their fixed dose times the model intensity. Adam ignores the constant c c except against their regularizer, so c c matches the L1 data term at the L1 run’s epoch-10 snapshot (training patterns). Calibrated at the empty model, it over-weights the regularizer 5–10 times late in training. The regularizer’s share of the loss still ends 1.5 times that of the L1 run on PrScO 3 . With 3 ​ c 3c the Poisson run reaches 0.724 at 50 epochs, against 0.754 at c c and 0.745 for L1, so on PrScO 3 the effect of the loss on torchslice is the size of the effect of the regularizer weight. • WSe 2 and PZT: the same pixel-object setup at each dataset’s geometry, with slices and sampling at the notebook’s non-dimensional values (2 slices of 6.5 Å and 41 of 5 Å; 0.12 and 0.11 λ / α \lambda/\alpha ); detector orientation and defocus for PZT screened on training loss. A one-row roll of the WSe 2 frame aligns its pattern center, which the code cannot fit. • Scoring: their forward model, reloaded from each snapshot, is cut to our 128-pixel window and scored by our likelihood. Held-out positions take the mean learned offset of their four neighbors. Gates: the reloaded forward reproduces the training run’s to 0 (bitwise) on four training patterns, and their input frame equals our counts bitwise, with the same held-out set. • Run to plateau (WSe 2 , one A6000): D H D_{H} of the L1 run falls from 1.105 at 50 epochs to 0.688 at 500 and 0.660 at 1,000, flat to 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} over its last 50 epochs. The Poisson run reaches 0.548, flat to 7 × 10 − 4 7\times 10^{-4} over its last 50 epochs. With ten times their object learning rate (tuned by us), L1 reaches 0.639 at 500 epochs and Poisson 0.458 at 1,000, flat to 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} over its last 50 epochs and still 0.051 above our solver. On PrScO 3 the same tuning makes L1 worse, 0.905 at 50 epochs against 0.745 as released, so the released rate stands there. Our solver: 0.4077 in 7 min. On PrScO 3 both arms still fall at 50 epochs (0.016 per 5 epochs). At 100 epochs L1 reaches 0.627 and Poisson 0.668, both still falling (L1 by 0.013 over the last 10 epochs), so our margin shrinks from 0.32–0.34 at the released 50 epochs to 0.21–0.25 (epochs 51–100 on an A4000, so no single-GPU time). • Time to accuracy on one A6000 (PrScO 3 ): torchslice needs 4.7 h for 50 epochs (337 s each) under either loss. Their papers judge a reconstruction by an information limit, a Fourier ring correlation against a known model or a repeated scan, SSIM, a training loss, or the scatter of positions over repeated unit cells ( Tab. S3 ). A small gap is not a good fit: torchslice at 50 epochs and fold_slice on PrScO 3 have gaps of 0.007 and 0.051 at D H D_{H} 1.105 and 0.736, both under-fitted.

blocks.en: Diederichs et al . fit atoms to experimental 4D-STEM data of a 20 nm PbZr 0.2 Ti 0.8 O 3 film, about five depths of field. Their differentiable multislice includes frozen phonons, five aberrations, a fitted partial-coherence ensemble, crystal tilt and scan positions, under an L1 loss on intensities. They report a spread of 2–4 pm over 25 unit cells, not a per-atom bar [ 11 ] . Herdegen et al . recover temperature in such inversions on simulated data [ 21 ] . Singh et al . fit isotropic Gaussian atoms to ptychographic phase projections for tomography [ 58 ] , and Mani et al . train a network on randomized Gaussian atoms to clean tomograms [ 41 ] . Both work on reconstructed images, not detector counts. Crystallographic refinement fits positions and displacement parameters to diffraction data by maximum likelihood [ 45 ] , and to cryo-EM maps in real space [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: Diederichs等将原子与20纳米PbZr 0.2 Ti 0.8 O 3胶片的实验性4D-STEM数据相匹配,约5个深度的球场. 它们的可分化多管包括:冷冻的相声、5个偏差、装有部分相通的相声、晶体倾斜和扫描姿势,在L1减速下。 他们报告说,在25个单元的细胞上, 下午2点至4点,而不是每个原子条[11]。 Herdegen等人在模拟数据中逆向恢复温度[21]。 Singh等. 将同位素高斯原子与图样相相位相相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 两者都致力于重建图像,而不是探测器计数. 晶体学的精细化将位置和移位参数相匹配,以最大概率为 [45] ,并在实际空间为 [1] 绘制低温-EM地图。

[ 11 ] (CC BY 4.0), 200 kV, 24.6 mrad, λ / α = 1.02 \lambda/\alpha=1.02 Å, 52 cells of 3.95 Å = 205 Å = 5.0 depths of field, step 0.35 Å = 0.34 λ / α \lambda/\alpha , 70 × 70 70\times 70 scan, EMPAD, 1.1 × 10 6 1.1\times 10^{6} e/Å 2 ( 1.2 × 10 6 1.2\times 10^{6} per resolution cell). PZT holds dark-subtracted ADU without a gain. We estimate 378 ADU/e from the single-electron peak and EMPAD calibrations scaled to 200 keV; a refit at 270 keeps every ranking (§S2). Its lattice ( a x = 3.95 a_{x}=3.95 , a y = 4.15 a_{y}=4.15 Å against 3.953 and 4.148 Å) confirms step and detector calibration to better than 1%. We report no atom positions for it. blocks.en:
On the sub-scan, the physics-built instrument halves the train–test gap at matched accuracy: free modes 0.299–0.307 (gap 0.025), physics-built 0.324 (0.012), physics-built + 2 modes 0.305 (0.012). On the full field (2,048 held-out patterns) the three give 0.2906 (gap 0.010), 0.3235 (0.006) and 0.2913 (0.008). The information limit is the largest frequency at which a lattice spot exceeds the 99th percentile of the noise maximum in its window. It is 0.41–0.49 Å = 0.17–0.20 λ / α \lambda/\alpha for free modes over three seeds and 0.45 Å with the physics-built instrument, against 0.46 Å for the published reconstruction. Requiring two symmetry-equivalent spots gives 0.49–0.52 and 0.46 Å, so the two are comparable, not ranked.
The free-mode fit takes 381 s on one V100; the published run took 16.7 h by its log, 158 × \times longer (19–113 × \times against the 2–12 h the article quotes). The published code, retrained without the held-out patterns, reaches 0.345 near 1,000 iterations and then over-fits (0.352 at 9,000), with transmission above 1 on 57% and then 94% of the field. Our physics-built fits reproduce across seeds to 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} .

blocks.en: S11. Timing and hardware
blocks.zh: S11 (英语). 时间和硬件

blocks.en: The 1,024-pattern sub-scan is recorded in about 1 s (1 ms per pattern; the full 128 × 128 128\times 128 scan takes 16 s). fold_slice reconstructs it in 20.5 h and PtyRAD in 22 min, 7 × 10 4 7\times 10^{4} and 1.3 × 10 3 1.3\times 10^{3} times the acquisition time (RTX A5000, published settings). Our free-mode fit passes both scores after 5.3 min on one RTX A6000, 3 × 10 2 3\times 10^{2} times the acquisition time; from a learned warm start it converges 3.1 × \times sooner (§S9). A ratio near one would let the fit steer the next scan.

Free-mode pixel fit of the public 10.3 mrad data (full 128 × 128 128\times 128 scan, 10 modes): 381 s on one V100. The published fold_slice run of the same data: 16.7 h on a V100 by its log (9,000 iterations at 6.7 s). fold_slice on the 25 mrad data at its published settings: 140 s per iteration on an RTX A5000 (15.6 h for stage 1, 4.9 h for stage 2). Atom model with frozen phonons ( K = 32 K=32 configurations, 81 coherence modes, no free modes, 1,702 atoms, 896 training patterns): exact pixel integration at bin 2 costs 850 s per gradient pass on two RTX A6000 (211 s with sinc pixels). The final two stages of the fit of Tab. 2 take 42 h wall on 2–5 RTX A6000 (118 GPU-hours), and the refit with the calibrated detector ellipse 24 h on six. Fisher-vector product on one A100: 1.7 s against 1.2 s for the likelihood and its gradient over 4,096 patterns. Depth block of the simulated bilayer: 2.8 h on an RTX 2080 Ti. The full field: 14 h on an RTX A6000 (start (i); A5000 for start (ii)). The 6 ∘ bilayer full field: 34 h on an RTX A6000. Free-mode pixel fit of PrScO 3 (full 64 × 64 64\times 64 scan, 21 slices): 403 s with 4 modes and 783 s with 8 modes on one A100 (6.5 and 12.7 s per pass over the 3,584 training patterns). PtyRAD takes 34 min for 200 iterations (10.2 s each), and fold_slice 95 min for 200 + 200 iterations. The published reconstruction of the full 128 × 128 128\times 128 scan (12 modes, 42 slices, 256-pixel patterns) took about 45 min per iteration for fewer than 100 iterations on a Quadro P5000 [ 6 ] . These A100 times are the 7 and 13 min of Tab. 2 . On one RTX A6000, the card of the torchslice comparison: our PrScO 3 fit takes 12.8 min with 4 modes and 25.1 min with 8 (L1 in place of the likelihood: the same), and torchslice 4.7 h for its 50 epochs under either loss (337 s per epoch over 3,584 patterns). On WSe 2 the times are 413 s against 249 s for its 50 epochs, and on PZT 15 and 30 min.

blocks.en: S12. Error budget
blocks.zh: S12 (英语). 预算出错

blocks.en: The Fisher bounds of §S4 are dose bounds that assume the model is right. This section projects measurement errors through the Fisher information of one reference fit of the 25 mrad bilayer, the budget fit , and compares them with the per-atom width misfit measured there. There the misfit, one Gauss–Newton step from the data, has a median of 3.5 (W) and 3.4 (Se) Fisher standard deviations (p90 14 and 8.9; last row of Tab. S5 ), where shot noise alone gives 1. The real per-atom bounds are 3–5 times the synthetic ones. The error budget identifies the measurement errors that account for this, and those below the shot-noise floor.
blocks.zh: §S4的费舍尔界限是假设模型是正确的剂量界限. 本节通过费舍尔信息对25毫拉德双层机的1个参考物的测量误差进行预测,预算适中,并与所测量的每个原子宽度误差进行比较。 错位,从数据中取出一高斯-牛顿阶,中位数为3.5(W)和3.4(Se) Fisher标准差(p90 14和8.9; Tab. S5的最后一行),仅拍出噪音即可得出 1. 实际每个原子的边界是合成的3至5倍。 误差预算识别出造成这种情况的测量误差,以及低于射入噪音下层的误差.

blocks.en: Two terms reach the measured scale. Switching thermal diffuse scattering off (mean field at the same U U ) biases W by 4.8 sd median and − 6.6 -6.6 pm on average. The model includes TDS, so only a fraction of this, the error of independent-atom frozen phonons, is a candidate. A uniform 20 mrad (1.1 ∘ ) tilt gives 3.3/9.8 sd for W, because the Se pair and the two layers shear by the tilt times their separation along the beam. With it the quadrature sum reaches 3.7/11 for W, matching the measurement, but only 1.7/5.4 for Se. The data do not favor a uniform tilt along the fast axis (best amplitude − 0.6 ± 0.03 -0.6\pm 0.03 of 10 mrad in training, not significant on held-out patterns). Fitting a tilt along the slow scan axis and one tilt per moiré region as nuisance parameters is the next step. It adds two to six parameters and repeats the per-atom Fisher pipeline (about 390 CPU node-hours for this sub-scan; §S16). It is not run here.

blocks.en: The real bounds are 3–5 times the synthetic ones. Three factors are measured at the budget fit. (i) Thermal diffuse scattering: at the same U U the static potential carries 3.9 times the diagonal width information of frozen phonons for W (1.3 for Se). Diffuse scattering returns to the detector much of what the Debye–Waller factor removes from the Bragg beams, and the synthetic bounds use the static potential. (ii) Detector disc: the scorer’s 71 mrad disc holds 58% of the width information of the full 106 mrad detector for both species. (iii) Marginalizing neighbors, stacked partners and the instrument widens the conditional sd by 1.40 (W) and 1.29 (Se). Together they give 3.7 of the 4.9 for W and 1.9 of the 3.2 for Se. We attribute the remaining factor of 1.3 (W) and 1.7 (Se) to the synthetic test: its truth widths (36–45 pm 2 against the fitted 26–27 pm 2 ) and its 13-slice static model carry more width information than the real data at the same dose. Closing it needs the synthetic coverage test rerun with frozen phonons at the fitted widths (about 60 GPU-hours), which is not done here. The cluster-by-pattern sandwich bounds are 1.6 (W) and 1.4 (Se) times the Fisher bounds (per-atom medians): the same misfit, seen from the score side. The ratio grows with the size of the pattern clusters, which share misfit, and its scores use K = 8 K=8 phonon configurations against the fit’s K = 32 K=32 (§S4). It indicates the misfit; it does not calibrate the bars.
blocks.zh: 真正的界限是合成的3到5倍。 三个因素按预算适当程度衡量。 (一) 热扩散散射:在同一U U,静态潜力为W(1.3为Se)所携带的对角宽度信息是被冻结的相声的3.9倍。 Diffuse 散射返回探测器, 大部分Debye - Waller因子从布拉格光束中取出的东西, (二) 探测器盘:计分器的71毫微分盘拥有两个物种106毫微分探测器全宽信息的58%。 (三)边际邻居,堆放伙伴和仪器将条件sd扩大1.40(W)和1.29(Se). 他们把4.9中的3.7(W)和3.2中的1.9(Se)加在一起。 我们把1.3(W)和1.7(Se)的剩余系数归为合成试验:其真伪宽度(36-45平方千米与所安装的26-27平方千米相比)及其13-切片静态模型携带的宽度信息比同一剂量的实际数据要多。 关闭它需要重新进行合成覆盖试验,在安装宽度(约60个GPU-hours)处用冷冻的相声进行,而这里没有做到这一点. 按式排列的三明治边框为1.6(W)和1.4(Se)倍于费舍尔边框(每原子中位数):相同的错位,从得分方看. 比例随着图案集群的大小而增长,它们共享出错的分数,其分数使用K=8 K=8phonon配置相對相對相對克=32 K=32 (§S4). 它表示不适;它不校正栏.

The bright-field rim is an ellipse: rim fits give semi-axes R ⁡ ( 1 ± ϵ ) R(1\pm\epsilon) with ϵ = 0.0097 \epsilon=0.0097 and the major axis at 55.6 ∘ 55.6^{\circ} from the detector x x axis, a distortion of the whole diffraction plane (it improves the dark field as well as the bright field, below). This is 1 − b / a = 1.9 % 1-b/a=1.9\% . Bright-field disks on other aberration-corrected microscopes are elliptical by 1–4% in the same measure. The projector and condenser settings set the ellipse. On one microscope, for each condenser aperture, its axis holds to within a few degrees over all camera lengths beyond the last projector-mode change, and its size to about a percentage point. It is therefore calibrated once per camera length and aperture. On the six scans of our session (about 90 min, two magnifications, five defoci), the rim gives ϵ = 0.0095 \epsilon=0.0095 to within 10 − 4 10^{-4} , the axis at 55.0–55.2 ∘ , and the same rim radius to 0.004 pixel. The value above, from the summed training patterns of the fitted sub-scan (896 of 1,024; held-out patterns do not enter), lies within the 1.3 × 10 − 4 1.3\times 10^{-4} scatter of single sub-scans.
The atom model can carry it as a fixed, area-preserving stretch of detector frequencies, calibrated from the rim and never fitted: aperture, aberrations, propagator and band limits see the stretched frequencies, the potential is synthesized at the matching sheared frequencies, and the scoring disc and detector pixels stay unchanged, with no resampling; at ϵ = 0 \epsilon=0 every array is unchanged. Switching it on for the converged atom fit lowers D H D_{H} from 0.4496 to 0.4318 without a refit (bright field 0.599 to 0.567, dark field 0.429 to 0.413); a refit gains another 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} and leaves the train–test gap at 0.005 ( Tab. 2 ). The refit lowers the species widths by 0.08 (W) and 0.03 pm (Se), within their sandwich bars, the rms atom displacement from the lattice from 0.41 to 0.32 Å, and the interlayer parameter from 6.74 to 6.69 Å. The free-mode pixel fit does not improve with the same correction, since its free modes absorb the distortion. The widths and bars quoted in the main text are those of the fit without the ellipse.

blocks.en: S15. Accuracy against published results
blocks.zh: S15 (英语). 对已公布结果的准确性

blocks.en: We read atom positions from the published reconstructions as a user would, with no structural priors. We use Gaussian fits in 2-D to the projected phase or to the max-phase image, and Huang et al . ’s 3-D peak retrieval (voxel maxima of the phase refined to sub-voxel by a spline) [ 22 ] . A 2-D peak cannot separate atoms closer than 0.35 Å in projection, so 2-D peaks are compared with the σ ​ V \sigma V -weighted centroids of such columns. Every set is aligned to its reference by one similarity transform (rotation and isotropic scale). The published simulated reconstruction used a scan step 0.9% long. With translation-only alignment it scores 19–23 pm against our 3.2 pm; the difference is the step calibration, not the method. Values are rms, with ours on the same atoms or columns in brackets.

blocks.en: • With no priors on either side, our in-plane error is 3.1–3.2 pm against 4.8 pm ( 1.9 × 10 − 2 1.9\times 10^{-2} against 2.9 × 10 − 2 ​ λ / α 2.9\times 10^{-2}\,\lambda/\alpha ), from either start. The advantage holds for both species, on overlapping columns, and in the outer 3 Å of the field (3.5 against 6.2–7.9 pm). • The priors move the published in-plane error only from 4.8 to 4.4 pm [ 22 ] . They act on depth, 84 / 127 to 5.3 / 5.5 pm. From the published reconstruction our depth error is about 3 times below the raw published peaks and 5–7 times above the refined coordinates (§S6). • Our in-plane error is 10 times our Fisher standard deviation (0.34 pm), and only 8% of atoms lie within one. The published peak-fit standard deviation understates its error by 3.5 times. Both methods are limited by model or readout error, not by the counts.
